rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Version identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Term or code used to identify the version of something.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Has parent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Reference to a parent object or legal person.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Additional remarks
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Mention of what deserves additional attention or notice.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Word or phrase that constitutes the distinctive designation of a being or thing.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Ontology identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Term or code used to identify something or someone registered within a particular ontology.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Version innovation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Documentation on what changed in comparison to a previously published form of something.
